overview.summary_en: Standard 25-raster cartographic and cliodynamic tensor suite for epoch 1900.
overview.summary_fr: Suite cartographique et tensorielle cliodynamique standard à 25 rasters pour l'époque 1900.

elevation.reconstitution_rationale: High-fidelity topography and bathymetry calibrated against epoch eustatic sea level offset.

biomes.reconstitution_rationale: Coupled Holdridge-Whittaker bioclimatic classification driven by empirical temperature and precipitation.

temperature.reconstitution_rationale: Empirical baseline modulated by continuous 2D orbital and continental paleoclimatic anomaly field.

precipitation.reconstitution_rationale: Empirical precipitation grid with dynamic ITCZ, monsoonal, and glacial humidity corrections.

seasonality.reconstitution_rationale: Continuous seasonality amplitude accounting for axial tilt, obliquity, and ocean thermal inertia.

data_sources: HYDE 3.4 History Database of the Global Environment

sovereignty.reconstitution_rationale: Multi-center polity sovereign domains and political borders.

data_sources: WALS World Atlas of Language Structures
isogloss.reconstitution_rationale: Global ethnolinguistic phyla, sub-branches, and dialectal zones.

data_sources: D-PLACE Murdock Ethnographic Atlas Kinship Codes
kinship.reconstitution_rationale: Spatial social structures, descent rules, and kinship organization modes.

rituals.reconstitution_rationale: Sacred geography, pilgrimage networks, and monumental ritual intensity.

technology.reconstitution_rationale: Technological complexity index and diffusion fronts.

institutional.reconstitution_rationale: Administrative hierarchy levels, legal infrastructure, and state capacity.

ecological.reconstitution_rationale: Anthropogenic ecological footprint, deforestation, and agro-pastoral soil transformation.

pathogen.reconstitution_rationale: Continuous epidemiological stress field, vector habitats, and zoonotic crowd disease risk.

tradenetwork.reconstitution_rationale: Maritime trade arteries, overland caravan routes, and commercial centrality hubs.

coal.reconstitution_rationale: Dual lithospheric reserve: total Carboniferous/Permian in-situ crustal endowment and surface outcrops.

oil.reconstitution_rationale: Crustal hydrocarbons reserve: total in-situ geological traps and surface bitumen seeps.

data_sources: USGS Conventional and Unconventional Natural Gas Resources
gas.reconstitution_rationale: Crustal conventional and tight gas reservoirs across major sedimentary basins.

data_sources: IAEA NFCIS World Distribution of Uranium Deposits (UDEPO)
uranium.reconstitution_rationale: Total crustal radioactive mineral reserves (unconformity, sandstone, and calcrete deposits).

helium3.reconstitution_rationale: Terrestrial abundance is zero; strictly exclusive to solar-wind irradiated airless regoliths.

data_sources: USGS MRDS Mineral Resources Data System
iron_copper.reconstitution_rationale: Total banded iron formations (BIFs) and porphyry copper belts plus ancient smelting centres.

data_sources: USGS MRDS Gold, Silver and PGM Deposits
precious_metals.reconstitution_rationale: Ancient historical mines (Las Médulas, Rio Tinto, Laurion, Roșia Montană, Nubia) and global giant provinces.

data_sources: USGS Critical Mineral Resources (REE, Lithium, Carbonatite Complexes)
rare_earths.reconstitution_rationale: Intrusive carbonatite complexes, pegmatite dykes, and lithium brine salars.

data_sources: Davies (2013) Global Mantle Heat Flow Database (IHFC)
geothermal.reconstitution_rationale: Empirical terrestrial surface heat flow (mW/m²) across mid-ocean ridges, rifts, and cratons.

data_sources: UNESCO WHYMAP Global Groundwater Resources of the World 2022
aquifers.reconstitution_rationale: Major regional sedimentary basin groundwater reservoirs modulated by elevation and lithological texture.
